summary: Phase 0 cannot be accepted. A1/A3/A5/A6/A7/A8-supervisor/A9 guards are clean and the Phase 0 fixture validator retains fail-closed behavior for malformed envelopes, tampered fixture hashes, empty corpora, and dangling catalog guards. However authentic distinct-role provenance is absent, the sole receipt contains placeholders and four stale output hashes, the plan overstates completion of severity/stop-loss/acceptance/revocation contracts, and the requested atomic-per-phase boundary was not honored (eight post-baseline commits). Repository-wide A8, A10, A12, and A13 findings remain open. This audit also found and guarded A14 (non-executable rg -nE detector recipes) and A15 (stale role-receipt hashes).
blocking_findings: Role provenance is not acceptable: measure/tests/evidence_integrity_gates/role-receipts/phase0.json:93-104 uses NOT_FABRICATED or runtime-placeholder values instead of tool-resolved spawn/event/context/final-response provenance, and lines 139-146 defer the required counterexample and adversarial roles.

A15: tests/orchestrator_role_receipt_integrity.sh reports stale SHA-256 attestations for manifest.json, control_claim.json, contracts.py, and test_contract_scaffold.py after Green/security-review edits; no later role receipt supersedes the Red receipt.

Plan truthfulness: plan.md:16 marks the severity, stop-loss, acceptance, and revocation contract task [x], but contracts.py:380-393 merely treats those names as optional non-empty envelope keys and defines no field schemas or semantic validation; the 46-test suite has no tests for their values.

Independent review is not acceptance evidence: review-b-security-result.json:11 is BLOCKED, lines 54-66 retain open High/Medium blockers, and no tool-attested reviewer receipt binds the review to a distinct author/event/context. The plan correctly leaves role spawning [~], so Phase 0 must remain incomplete.

Atomic-per-phase instruction was not honored: fc8aaa73..d3fa8726 contains eight post-baseline commits for Phase 0 (Green, plan update, three implementation fixes, two documentation/version syncs, and review receipt) rather than one atomic phase boundary; all Git commits also have the same repository author identity and cannot establish role separation.
A8 aggregate: tests/orchestrator_marker_vocabulary.sh exits 1 on deprecated [ ] markers in multiple active plans. The focused supervisor regex remains correct, but the live registry contract is red.

A12: seven catalog guard references are still dangling (tests/_lib/track_dir.sh, tests/cs_p4.sh, tests/mir_p1.sh, tests/mr_p1.sh through tests/mr_p4.sh). sweep_phase0 correctly returns ok=false, so no aggregate completion claim is allowed.
A13: measure/tracks/agents_md_audit_science_advantage_20260603 remains as a stale active directory while tracks.md points to its archive and the active directory has no plan.md.
nonblocking_findings: A10: .git/hooks/pre-commit is absent. measure/generate.sh now exists in the worktree, but generated-facts regeneration is still manual and drift-prone.
A14 maintenance fix: six invalid rg -nE recipes in measure/anti-patterns.md were corrected to rg -n and tests/orchestrator_detector_syntax.sh was added; the new guard passes.
AGENTS.md:675 contains the required peer-reviewed supervisor rule, not the retired blanket do-not-modify rule. No supervisor change occurred in Phase 0.
A2 is not applicable to the four existing tests/*.sh files because none is a Phase 4/closeout publish gate; no consent-blind publication transition was found.
A3, A7, and A9 corrected detector runs produced no hits in tests/*.sh; A5 produced no matching active-plan claim; A6 produced no matching registry overstatement.

The strategy says allowed-input hashes and role receipts are frozen; four receipt hashes no longer match HEAD.

The strategy requires severity, stop-loss, acceptance, and revocation contracts, but current tests only exercise envelope presence/status/baseline/schema and do not falsify malformed values for those fields.
